name: Stellar Dancer Dedication
prerequisites: trained in either Nature or Fey Lore
text:
Access You were granted permission to learn it by a member of the Starlit Crown.

---
You've begun learning the stellar dance, a storied fey art that celebrates the celestial bodies. You become an expert in Performance. If you were already an expert, you instead become trained in your choice of Nature or Fey Lore. You also gain the Stellar Dance Stance action.
